reviewer: Primary agent; manual source/control-flow and bound-executable disassembly inspection; no delegated reviews or program execution.

reviews.summary: The unmodified CLI iteration count controls the timed outer loop. Each iteration calls the OpenMP static row loop across all numRows; its inner loop traverses every CSR nonzero and overwrites the complete output. Initialization and the optional reference precede timing. No repetition shortcut or data-dependent omission was identified.

compiled_evidence.claim: Clock calls 199f/1a1a surround GOMP_parallel 1a09 with iteration backedge 1a11->19e0. Worker 1fa0 partitions all rows using the OpenMP quotient/remainder calculation, retains multiply/add 204d/2055, nonzero backedge 205c->2040 and row backedge 206b->2020. Each executable was inspected separately.
